name: @mesh/shell-ui-interface
description: UI extension point contracts: the named regions a host surface renders foreign module UI into.

mesh.settings.page.description: A settings page mounted into a settings frontend. Any module may contribute one; any settings frontend may host the point.

props.name: namespace
props.description: Settings namespace the page reads and writes; defaults to the contributing module id

props.name: title
props.description: Page title shown by the host

props.name: icon
props.description: Semantic icon name for the host's navigation
